subject: Implement Layer 3 query execution MCP tools
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/tools/query_tools.py` with 2 MCP tool definitions for Layer 3 query execution.

Tools to register with FastMCP:
1. `execute_query(sql: str, params: dict | list | None = None, limit: int = 1000, timeout_ms: int | None = None) -> str`
   - Calls QueryService.execute_query
   - `params` supports both named dict (`:param`) and positional list (`?`)
   - `limit` range: 1-10000
   - Returns JSON-serialized ExecuteQueryOutput
2. `explain_query(sql: str, params: dict | list | None = None, format: str = "text") -> str`
   - Calls QueryService.explain_query
   - `format` accepts "text" or "json"
   - Returns JSON-serialized ExplainQueryOutput

Each tool must:
- Have a descriptive docstring emphasizing read-only nature
- Extract pool from server context
- Call the appropriate service method
- Handle errors via create_tool_error
- Use `@mcp.tool()` decorator

Register tools with the FastMCP server.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Both tools registered with FastMCP
- [ ] `execute_query` enforces read-only validation before execution
- [ ] `execute_query` supports both positional and named parameters
- [ ] `explain_query` returns formatted execution plan
- [ ] `limit` validated (1-10000 range)

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] `params=None`: no parameters passed to hdbcli
- [ ] `timeout_ms=None`: uses config default

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Write attempt: clear WRITE_OPERATION_DENIED message
- [ ] Timeout: QUERY_TIMEOUT with suggestion
- [ ] Invalid SQL syntax: INVALID_SQL error

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Each tool with mocked QueryService
• Unit: Parameter validation (limit range, format values)
• Unit: Error wrapping for write attempts

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.3, 9.2
